title: Observability and Social Interactions in Consumption
title_zh: 消费中的可观察性与社会互动
title_primary: 消费中的可观察性与社会互动
title_secondary: Observability and Social Interactions in Consumption
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines how social context affects consumption responses to transitory income shocks. Using a randomized survey experiment embedded in the Italian Survey of Consumer Expectations, we vary whether an unexpected €1,000 employer-specific bonus is observable to coworkers and whether it is received only by the respondent or by all coworkers. The design separately identifies the effect of observability for an idiosyncratic bonus and the incremental effect of making a publicly observable bonus common within the workplace, a well-defined social context. Making an idiosyncratic bonus publicly observable reduces the MPC by about 3 percentage points relative to a private idiosyncratic bonus. Conditional on observability, making the bonus common among coworkers raises the MPC by about 6 percentage points. Interpreted through a linear social-interactions model, the latter effect implies a social-interaction parameter of approximately 0.16 and a social multiplier of about 1.2. These findings suggest that aggregate consumption responses to fiscal policy depend not only on individual behavior but also on the social context in which income changes occur.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨社会情境如何影响消费对暂时性收入冲击的反应。通过嵌入意大利消费者预期调查中的随机调查实验，我们改变了以下变量：一笔1000欧元雇主特定奖金是否被同事观察到，以及该奖金仅由受访者获得还是由所有同事共同获得。该实验设计分别识别了个人特定奖金的可观察性效应，以及将公开可观察奖金转化为工作场所共同奖金（一种明确界定的社会情境）的增量效应。相较于私人个人特定奖金，将个人特定奖金公开化会使边际消费倾向降低约3个百分点。在可观察性条件下，将奖金转化为同事共同奖金则使边际消费倾向提高约6个百分点。通过线性社会互动模型进行解释，后者效应意味着社会互动参数约为0.16，社会乘数约为1.2。这些发现表明，财政政策引发的总消费反应不仅取决于个体行为，还取决于收入变化发生时的社会情境。

title: DP515 Should Rules be Simple?
official: 官方在线 1991-03-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The principal argument of the paper is that in an incomplete information setting, where the private sector lacks information of government objectives and has to learn about the policy rule by direct observation and estimation, simple ‘sub-optimal’ rules may outperform the more complicated rule which is optimal under complete information. This result is demonstrated by simulations using an overlapping contract rational expectations model. The paper thus provides some formal reasoning to support arguments for simplicity associated with credibility and the need for the private sector to be able to monitor policy.
abstract_zh: 本文的核心论点是，在信息不完全的环境下，当私人部门缺乏对政府目标的了解，必须通过直接观察和估计来学习政策规则时，简单的“次优”规则可能优于在完全信息条件下最优的复杂规则。这一结论通过使用重叠合同理性预期模型的模拟得以验证。因此，本文为支持与可信度相关的简单性论点，以及私人部门需具备监督政策能力的主张，提供了形式化的理论依据。此为订阅内容预览，请通过机构登录以确认访问权限。

title: Information and Macroeconomic Expectations: Global Evidence
title_zh: 信息与宏观经济预期：全球证据
title_primary: 信息与宏观经济预期：全球证据
title_secondary: Information and Macroeconomic Expectations: Global Evidence
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Unique global data on 47,000 consumers across 47 countries representing 90% of world GDP reveal universal patterns in macroeconomic belief formation. Most consumers form beliefs based on local information sources (utility bills, shopping, and acquaintances) that provide signals not representative for the overall consumption bundle, so that seeking information leads to forming biased macroeconomic expectations. Distrust in governments and central banks, the producers of aggregate economic information, helps explain reliance on local sources and the lack of learning from aggregate realizations. Observed macroeconomic volatility fuels distrust. In the cross-section, we confirm that certain demographics correlate with expectation biases but mostly due to different sorting into information sources, rather than different processing of the same economic information. These globally established facts inform advances of theories of belief formation and the design of communication strategies as a macroeconomic policy tool.
abstract_zh: 覆盖全球47个国家、代表全球90%GDP的47,000名消费者的独特全球数据揭示了宏观经济信念形成的普遍模式。大多数消费者基于本地信息源（水电账单、购物经历及熟人）形成信念，这些信息源提供的信号无法代表整体消费组合，因此信息寻求反而导致形成有偏的宏观经济预期。对生产总体经济信息的政府与中央银行的不信任，有助于解释消费者依赖本地信息源以及未能从总体经济实现中学习的原因。观测到的宏观经济波动加剧了这种不信任。在横截面分析中，我们证实某些人口统计特征与预期偏差相关，但这主要源于不同群体对信息源的选择差异，而非对相同经济信息处理方式的差异。这些全球性实证发现为信念形成理论的发展以及作为宏观经济政策工具的沟通策略设计提供了依据。

title: The Use and Misuse of Average and Marginal Energy Prices: Implications for Climate Policy
title_zh: 平均与边际能源价格的使用与误用：对气候政策的启示
title_primary: 平均与边际能源价格的使用与误用：对气候政策的启示
title_secondary: The Use and Misuse of Average and Marginal Energy Prices: Implications for Climate Policy
authors: Jonathan T. Hawkins-Pierot, Katherine R.H. Wagner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Many governments and institutions use marginal price signals, such as fuel and carbon taxes, to meet emission reduction targets. However, the responses of firms and individuals to these price signals are often calculated using average prices commonly reported in economic data, rather than marginal prices. This paper first documents that the marginal price of electricity paid by U.S. manufacturing plants is 50% lower than the average price. To do so, we construct a novel dataset of both average and marginal electricity prices, and the wedge between these, using plant-level microdata from the U.S. Census and utility-level electricity rate schedules for over two hundred utilities. Second, we provide guidance on when average prices are an appropriate proxy for marginal prices in price elasticities by identifying economic and geographic characteristics that predict variation in this wedge. Overall, the magnitude of this wedge suggests that the standard use of average energy prices to calculate responses to carbon taxes may underestimate the energy price increases needed to meet emissions targets by 50%.
abstract_zh: 许多政府与机构采用边际价格信号（如燃油税与碳税）以实现减排目标。然而，企业与个人对这些价格信号的响应，通常基于经济数据中普遍报告的平均价格而非边际价格进行计算。本文首先发现，美国制造业工厂支付的电价边际价格比平均价格低50%。为此，我们利用美国人口普查局的工厂级微观数据及覆盖两百多家公用事业公司的电价费率表，构建了包含平均电价、边际电价及其差额的新型数据集。其次，通过识别预测该差额变化的经济与地理特征，本文为平均价格在何种情况下可作为边际价格弹性分析的合理代理变量提供了指导。总体而言，这一差额的规模表明：若以标准方式使用平均能源价格计算碳税响应，可能使实现排放目标所需的能源价格涨幅被低估50%。

title: Screening and Segmenting: A Consumer Surplus Perspective
title_zh: 筛选与细分：消费者剩余视角
title_primary: 筛选与细分：消费者剩余视角
title_secondary: Screening and Segmenting: A Consumer Surplus Perspective
authors: Dirk Bergemann, Tibor Heumann, Michael Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We analyze consumer surplus when a monopolist can adjust both prices and product qualities across segments, engaging in second- and third-degree price discrimination simultaneously. We characterize the consumer-optimal segmentation and show that it has a striking structure: consumers with the same value receive the same quality in every segment, though prices differ. Under mild conditions, any segmentation harms consumers if and only if demand is sufficiently more elastic than supply. Hence, potential benefits for consumers depend critically on demand and supply elasticities. These findings have implications for regulatory policy regarding price discrimination and market segmentation.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了垄断者在不同细分市场中同时调整价格与产品质量、实施二级与三级价格歧视时的消费者剩余。我们刻画了消费者最优细分结构，并揭示其具有显著特征：在每一细分市场中，具有相同价值的消费者获得相同质量，但价格存在差异。在温和条件下，当且仅当需求弹性显著大于供给弹性时，任何细分都会损害消费者利益。因此，消费者潜在收益关键取决于需求与供给弹性。这些发现对价格歧视与市场细分的监管政策具有启示意义。

title: The Economic Costs of Religious Riots in India
title_zh: 印度宗教骚乱的经济成本
title_primary: 印度宗教骚乱的经济成本
title_secondary: The Economic Costs of Religious Riots in India
authors: Iyer, Sriya, Petrukhin, Dmitrii, Shrivastava, Anand
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper estimates the economic effects of communal riots in India using a new district-year panel for 1994-2013 that combines extended riot data with nightlights, manufacturing outcomes, infrastructure, and district-level credit. To address endogeneity, we use quasi-random variation generated when major Hindu festivals fall on a Friday (Fridays draw large Muslim congregations for weekly prayers) and construct a spatially weighted instrument for local riot risk. Instrumental variable estimates show that higher riot exposure leads to sizable and persistent economic losses. A one-unit increase in distance-weighted exposure reduces nightlights by about 0.105 log points, implying a GDP decline of roughly 0.45%. We trace several channels, including contractions in firm output and employment, fewer bank branches, less agricultural credit, and a thinner market infrastructure. Using the timing of household surveys relative to riots, we also find that trust in state institutions declines. Together, the results quantify the economic costs of communal riots and identify the mechanisms through which social conflict depresses local economic activity.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1994-2013年印度地区-年份面板数据，将扩展的骚乱数据与夜间灯光、制造业产出、基础设施及地区信贷相结合，评估了社区骚乱的经济影响。为解决内生性问题，我们利用印度主要印度教节日恰逢周五（周五吸引大量穆斯林群体参加每周祈祷）所产生的准随机变异，构建了衡量当地骚乱风险的空间加权工具变量。工具变量估计表明，更高的骚乱暴露度会导致显著且持续的经济损失。距离加权暴露度每增加一个单位，夜间灯光指数下降约0.105个对数点，相当于GDP下降约0.45%。我们追溯了若干传导渠道，包括企业产出与就业收缩、银行网点减少、农业信贷萎缩以及市场基础设施薄弱。通过利用家庭调查相对于骚乱发生的时间节点，我们还发现对国家机构的信任度有所下降。综合来看，这些结果量化了社区骚乱的经济成本，并揭示了社会冲突抑制地方经济活动的机制。

title: The impact of new products on ethical beliefs
title_zh: 新产品对伦理信念的影响
title_primary: 新产品对伦理信念的影响
title_secondary: The impact of new products on ethical beliefs
authors: Zach Freitas-Groff, Bobbie Macdonald, Eva Vivalt
official: 官方在线 August 202 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Does technological change affect ethical beliefs? We study the case of synthetic alternatives to meat products using an incentivized survey experiment. One might expect that the possibility of an improved alternative would increase objections to meat production on moral grounds because it reduces the cost of avoiding meat. Instead, we find that informing consumers of a new alternative decreases moral objections to conventional animal farming relative to a control. Participants who are experimentally nudged to view the new alternative relatively more positively do indeed report more moral concern for animal welfare. The findings suggest a backlash effect in which people react to innovation by increasing their support for existing practices, but depending on how positively they view the alternative.

title: Infrastructure expansion, tourism and electoral outcomes
title_zh: 基础设施扩张、旅游业与选举结果
title_primary: 基础设施扩张、旅游业与选举结果
title_secondary: Infrastructure expansion, tourism and electoral outcomes
abstract: This paper examines the electoral impact of economic growth through increased foreign tourism using data from Croatia. To identify causal effects, the paper applies an instrumental variable strategy, which uses variation in the ruggedness of the local terrain to estimate the network of least-cost paths. The results suggest that an increase in foreign tourism reduces nationalist voting, and increases the centre-left vote share. In addition, I find that the increase in tourism rates led to population and employment growth, demographic shifts within municipalities, and positive spillovers on manufacturing, providing several potential mechanisms behind the voting results.

title: Consumer preferences for sustainability labels: A comparative analysis of the green-score and other established labels
title_zh: 消费者对可持续性标签的偏好：绿色评分与其他成熟标签的比较分析
title_primary: 消费者对可持续性标签的偏好：绿色评分与其他成熟标签的比较分析
title_secondary: Consumer preferences for sustainability labels: A comparative analysis of the green-score and other established labels
authors: Francesco Vella, Rodolfo M. Nayga, Riccardo Vecchio, Wei Yang, Giuseppina Rizzo 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: • A representative sample of Italian consumers participated in a Choice Experiment. • Green-Score is more effective than organic at increasing WTP for sustainable food. • The effectiveness of labels varies widely across different food product categories. • Salience nudges increase consumer preference for the Green-Score label. • PDO certification remains the most influential for culturally significant products. The Green-Score label aims to complement established certifications by providing a standardized and easily interpretable assessment of products’ environmental performance. This study examines (i) the relative influence of Green-Score, organic, and Protected Designation of Origin (PDO) certifications on consumers’ willingness to pay (WTP); (ii) how label effectiveness varies across food categories; and (iii) the impact of a salience nudge on consumer choices. A Discrete Choice Experiment was conducted with a nationally representative sample of 1,102 Italian consumers, using a between-subjects design to evaluate the nudge. Results show that PDO labels, leveraging strong institutional credibility and symbolic value, consistently generate the highest marginal WTP (€7.61), especially for culturally and traditionally significant products. Green-Score A+ labels, valued for their diagnosticity and cross-product comparability, achieve an average marginal WTP of €6.25, slightly above organic certification (€4.59), with variation across product categories and treatment conditions. The salience nudge enhances the perceived value of Green-Score, particularly in contexts where environmental performance is salient, and can reduce the marginal contribution of overlapping labels such as organic certification. These findings demonstrate that the effectiveness of sustainability labels depends on both the balance between credibility and diagnosticity and the product-specific context, offering actionable insights for policymakers and stakeholders seeking to design targeted and effective environmental labelling strategies in food markets.
abstract_zh: • 一项以意大利消费者代表性样本为对象的选择实验。 • 在提升可持续食品支付意愿方面，Green-Score比有机认证更有效。 • 标签的有效性在不同食品产品类别间差异显著。 • 显著性助推增加了消费者对Green-Score标签的偏好。 • 对于具有文化意义的产品，PDO认证仍最具影响力。Green-Score标签旨在通过提供标准化且易于理解的产品环境绩效评估，补充现有认证体系。本研究考察了：(i) Green-Score、有机认证和原产地保护认证（PDO）对消费者支付意愿（WTP）的相对影响；(ii) 标签有效性在不同食品类别间的差异；以及(iii) 显著性助推对消费者选择的影响。研究采用离散选择实验，以1,102名意大利消费者的全国代表性样本为对象，并通过受试者间设计评估助推效果。结果表明，PDO标签凭借强大的制度公信力和象征价值，持续产生最高的边际支付意愿（€7.61），尤其对具有文化和传统意义的产品效果显著。Green-Score A+标签因其诊断性和跨产品可比性而受到重视，平均边际支付意愿为€6.25，略高于有机认证（€4.59），且在不同产品类别和处理条件下存在差异。显著性助推增强了Green-Score的感知价值，尤其在环境绩效显著的情境中，并可能降低有机认证等重叠标签的边际贡献。这些发现表明，可持续标签的有效性既取决于公信力与诊断性之间的平衡，也取决于产品特定情境，为政策制定者和利益相关者设计食品市场中针对性且有效的环境标签策略提供了可操作的见解。

title: Bonding with risk: Corporate investment and savings in risky financial assets
title_zh: 风险共担：企业风险金融资产投资与储蓄
title_primary: 风险共担：企业风险金融资产投资与储蓄
title_secondary: Bonding with risk: Corporate investment and savings in risky financial assets
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the rationale behind firms’ investment in risky financial assets by formulating and estimating a dynamic model in which firms allocate their precautionary savings to both safe and risky securities. In equilibrium, risky financial asset holdings are positively related to the sensitivity of a firm’s financing deficit to the risky asset returns—the “financing deficit beta”. Using a comprehensive sample of US corporate financial asset holdings, we find evidence of a positive correlation between risky financial asset holdings and financing deficit betas that capture firms’ incentives to hedge interest-rate risk. Precautionary motives are stronger in small, high-volatility, and R&D-intensive firms.

title: When Is Discrimination Unfair?
authors: Peter Kuhn, Trevor Osaki, Lei Yue
abstract: We use a vignette-based survey experiment to elicit respondents’ assessments of the fairness of race-based hiring decisions and compare these assessments with the predictions of four preregistered ethical frameworks. While conservative respondents are much more accepting of discriminatory actions than others, respondents of all political leanings rate the relative fairness of different actions in a very similar way. A two-group framework in which one group (mostly self-described conservatives) values employers’ decision rights, the other has utilitarian concerns, and both groups use the same race-blind rules to assign relative fairness levels to actions explains our data well.
abstract_zh: 我们采用基于情境描述的调查实验，来获取受访者对基于种族的雇佣决策公平性的评估，并将这些评估与四个预注册伦理框架的预测进行比较。尽管保守派受访者比其他人更接受歧视性行为，但所有政治倾向的受访者对不同行为的相对公平性评价方式非常相似。一个双群体框架——其中一组（主要是自称保守派的人）重视雇主的决策权，另一组具有功利主义关切，且两组都使用相同的种族中立规则来为行为分配相对公平等级——很好地解释了我们的数据。
